latest.headline: Nvidia beat lifts MU to $730 pre-market; the bounce is fading
latest.tldr: MU closed Tuesday at $712.42 (−0.92%) after a round trip to $666.88, last printed $729.98 (+2.46%) at 7:06 ET on Nvidia's beat, and I expect an open about 0.5% to 4.5% higher, leaning to the lower half because the bounce has shrunk all night.
